Account.description: An account as its owner sees it.

email.description: Its address, as it signed up with it.

language.description: The language code of its emails and interface.

storage.description: Its documents' bytes and its quota.

AccountChange.description: A change of the account: its language.

language.description: The language code of its emails and interface, one of `languages.json`.

AccountExport.description: A data export: a zip laid out like a local library, plus `account.json`.

Animation.description: An animation of the account's library, without its document.

documentBytes.description: The size of its document, in bytes: what it counts against the quota.

updatedAt.description: When its document last changed, or it moved.

version.description: Its version: the `ETag` of its document, which a write names in `If-Match`.

projectId.description: The project to move it to.

AnimationDocument.description: A document, as the model serializes it: the format of the local library's files.

EventName.description:
The one name the app's allow-list accepts today (`docs/v1/server.md`, H13); any other value
fails to deserialize, and answers `request.malformed`.

EventRequest.description: A product event the app reports, with the browsing context every one of them carries.

ExportCompletedProperties.description: `export_completed`'s properties: the format downloaded and its raw, uncompressed size.

ExportFormat.description: The format a completed export used, as `docs/v1/service.md` fixes the list.

status.description: Always `ok`: a server that cannot answer sends a problem.

HealthStatus.description: The status of a healthy server.

Page_Animation.description: A page of a list, from the most recently updated item.

items.description: An animation of the account's library, without its document.

documentBytes.description: The size of its document, in bytes: what it counts against the quota.

updatedAt.description: When its document last changed, or it moved.

version.description: Its version: the `ETag` of its document, which a write names in `If-Match`.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

Page_Project.description: A page of a list, from the most recently updated item.

items.description: A project of the account's library.

updatedAt.description: When it or one of its animations last changed.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

Page_SupportRequestSummary.description: A page of a list, from the most recently updated item.

items.description: A request of the account, without its messages.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it; the screenshot itself is never served back.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

PasswordResetConfirmation.description: A new password, with the token of the emailed link.

PasswordResetRequest.description: A request for a link setting a new password.

Problem.description:
An error, as RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code and its parameters, never a
sentence: the interface translates `errors.<code>`.

code.description: The stable code, dot-separated `snake_case` segments, domain first.

params.description: The parameters of the code's message, with camelCase keys.

Project.description: A project of the account's library.

updatedAt.description: When it or one of its animations last changed.

ProjectName.description: A project's name: to create, rename or duplicate it.

Session.description: A session: the account signed in, and the token its unsafe requests send in `X-CSRF-Token`.

csrfToken.description: The CSRF token of the session.

email.description: The address; spaces around it are ignored.

language.description: The language code of the interface, one of `languages.json`.

SupportCategory.description: What a support request is about.

SupportReplyRequest.description: A reply of the account to one of its requests.

body.description: The reply: 1 to 5,000 characters once trimmed.

screen.description:
The route template of the screen the person was on, `/editor/:animationId`: never a URL
with ids.

SupportRequestForm.description: The form a request is sent as: its description, the handler reads the parts one by one.

context.description: What the app attaches without asking.

message.description: The message: 1 to 5,000 characters once trimmed.

screenshot.description:
A PNG or a JPEG of at most 4,096 pixels a side and 5,242,880 bytes, re-encoded as PNG
before it is stored; an empty part counts as none.

SupportRequestMessage.description: A message of a request: never an internal note of the team.

SupportRequestSummary.description: A request of the account, without its messages.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it; the screenshot itself is never served back.

SupportRequestThread.description: A request of the account and its messages, oldest first: the first is the request's own.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it; the screenshot itself is never served back.

messages.description: Its messages, the team's internal notes left out.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: The token of an emailed verification link.
